guest.notes: api 30; container-backed guest via an adapter, not a qemu machine

constraints: no modem and no ril: no sim, no sms, no calls, no esim claims - the honest-labeling rule applies here hard
attestation fails by construction: this is a testing lane, never a pool identity

gpu is software rendered unless a host gpu is available: fine for data work, useless for anything visual
